Corrected. The article governs a substantival adjective, so the supplied generic noun ones is the article's own (rules 17, 102); rule 17's generic-noun clause is scoped to anarthrous Greek, and here an article stands to take the supplied noun. The demonstrative these displaces the determiner slot and nothing else (rules 38, 49), so the article is not thereby emptied.
